versions.content: Calling Dem in case of no data value error If data element invalidation is enabled (the handleInvalid has any value other than dontInval- idate ) or out-of-range check is enabled ( the handleOutOfRange has any value other than none ) for a data element, the RTE shall invoke the Dem_SetEventStatus 412 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 API with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED if the attribute ISignalPortToDiag- nosticEventMapping . dataValueError is configured.
